postcard.title: Indoor cat
postcard.note: Douliana morning — woke up with him already inside.
postcard.caption: Douliana, morning. Woke up with him inside — no key, no knock, just a tabby on the tiles.

lines.text: Why are you yelling at me?
I’m enjoying my day here, why are you yelling at me? I don’t make the rules, that’s your problem.

word.meaning: Island. Today that means Spinalonga — and the water around it.
